_README: DEBT, NOT APPROVAL, and it may only FALL. Each entry is the whole-tree count a diff-scoped gate
finds when run with --full-tree (base = the empty tree). A count ABOVE the entry fails; a count
below it asks to be lowered, because a ratchet nobody tightens stops being one.
WHY THESE NUMBERS EXIST AT ALL: of the CI steps, 14 are whole-tree and 4 are diff-scoped, so code
merged before a diff gate existed is never examined by it. That backlog was invisible by
construction rather than by neglect. --full-tree is nightly/release only and NEVER a PR gate: on a
PR it would report the inherited backlog as that PR's findings.
NEVER raise a count to make a run pass. Raising it records that something was merged unexamined.

xss-sink-gate.unit: innerHTML sinks carrying an unescaped identifier (the WORK unit; a file holds ~5)
xss-sink-gate.note: Metric CHANGED 2026-10-11 from files (42) to unescaped SINKS (210 of 314 in the tree), because the file count was blind to the work: a file leaves the list only when its LAST sink is escaped, so escaping four of five moves it by zero. Measured, not argued — #3437 escaped sinks in dex-profile.js and resp-acc-analysis-app.js, both of which REMAIN listed because they hold others, and the file count stayed 42. `files` is kept as a second column: the right unit for how many modules still need review, the wrong one for progress. Seeded 2026-10-10. Tightened 2026-10-15: 210 → 209 (a sink was fixed on main without tightening the baseline; the ratchet reported SHORTFALL). The 7 open js/xss-through-dom CodeQL alerts are the control and all 7 are in this list; the first run found only 6 of 7, because a sink whose right-hand side sits on the NEXT line read as safe (empty RHS, no identifier found) while still counting as examined. Fixing that assembly raised the count from 33 to 42, so nine further files had been hidden by the same shape. The scanner remains a heuristic, not AST-based.
xss-sink-gate.filesUnit: files containing at least one such sink — reported, NOT ratcheted

absence-regression.note: Seeded 2026-10-10 over 122,261 scanned lines. The single hit is integrator-dsp.js:7325 — `tMs: b.t0Ms != null ? b.t0Ms : startMs || 0` — which guards b.t0Ms properly and then falls back to `startMs || 0`, so a missing startMs stamps 1970 (§∅). Recorded rather than fixed here: this PR adds the measurement, and changing a DSP export belongs to its own unit with its own fixture regeneration. LOWERED 1 -> 0 on 2026-10-11: the site was fixed in #3393 (integrator-dsp.js:7325), so the whole-tree count is now 0 over 122,261 scanned lines. The ratchet asked for this in words - "backlog FELL to 0 from 1 - lower the baseline" - which is the SHORTFALL state doing its job.
